column1: # Packages bundled with the BEAST installers (issue #248). One line per package:
# <name in version.xml><TAB><version><TAB><URL of the released zip><TAB><SHA-256 of the zip>
# release/Windows/assemble-bundle.sh) download exactly these files with
# release/common/fetch-bundled-packages.sh, check each checksum, and put the zips in the
# bundle's packages/ folder, where the launcher seeds them on first launch.
# For each release candidate, the packages are built against that candidate and released,
# and this list points to those releases (release/README.md, "Bundled packages").
# Pinned 12 Nov 2026: the latest release of each package, built against earlier 2.8.0
# builds. They load and work with master (beast3#248, comment of 12 Nov); to be replaced
